meta.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
meta.description: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

videos.title: I Accidentally Vaporize My Pre-Algebra Teacher
videos.overview: Expelled from school, Percy Jackson unravels who he is, confronting a world of gods and monsters.

videos.title: I Become Supreme Lord of the Bathroom
videos.overview: Percy finds his place at Camp Half Blood, where he learns just how special his origins may be.

videos.title: We Visit the Garden Gnome Emporium
videos.overview: Percy sets off on the quest to return Zeus' master bolt and stop a war between the gods.

videos.title: I Plunge to My Death
videos.overview: Our heroes search for a refuge in St Louis, and come face to face with the mother of all monsters.

videos.title: A God Buys Us Cheeseburgers
videos.overview: The quest deepens as Percy, Annabeth, and Grover are tasked with a favor from a fearsome opponent.

videos.title: We Take a Zebra to Vegas
videos.overview: Percy, Annabeth, and Grover must resist the alluring draw of a casino that feels outside of time.

videos.title: We Find Out the Truth, Sort Of
videos.overview: Our heroes journey across the Underworld, and bargain for their safety with the god of the dead.

videos.title: The Prophecy Comes True
videos.overview: Mount Olympus beckons... and Percy must face his greatest battle yet.

videos.title: I Play Dodgeball with Cannibals
videos.overview: Percy, Annabeth, and Tyson race to defend Camp Half-Blood from dangerous forces.

videos.title: Demon Pigeons Attack
videos.overview: Percy and Annabeth contend with a new activities director as they try to locate Grover.

videos.title: We Board the Princess Andromeda
videos.overview: Aboard a cruise ship, our heroes struggle to differentiate friend from foe.

videos.title: Clarisse Blows Up Everything
videos.overview: Quests collide as our crew voyages into the perilous Sea of Monsters.

videos.title: We Check In to C.C.'s Spa & Resort
videos.overview: Percy and Annabeth must confront their flaws at a resort sanctuary.

videos.title: Nobody Gets the Fleece
videos.overview: Percy and Annabeth go undercover on an island to rescue their friends.

videos.title: I Go Down with the Ship
videos.overview: With a friend in danger, our heroes must risk everything to continue their quest.

videos.title: The Fleece Works Its Magic Too Well
videos.overview: Our heroes race to save camp as Luke and Kronos’ army advances.

meta.slogan: A Titan's curse. A hero's destiny.
